title: Analyzing Dialectical Biases in LLMs for Knowledge and Reasoning Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Translating Standard American English multiple-choice question answering datasets (BoolQ, SciQ, MMLU) into six specific English dialects (e.g., African American English, Singaporean English, Chicano English) using the Multi-VALUE rule-based translation tool, and comparing LLM zero-shot accuracy between the standard and dialect-perturbed versions.
